security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'self' blob:;

bundle.longDescription: A free, local-first PDF editor for editing, signing, redaction, forms, OCR, compression, and document cleanup without subscriptions, accounts, or cloud uploads.

cli.longDescription: Run an action workflow from the command line. Use --action <file.action.json> with --input <file-or-folder> to batch-process without opening the UI.

args.name: action
args.description: Path to an .action.json file defining the workflow

args.name: input
args.description: Input file or folder to run the action on
